task.objective: Did my flight leave on time? I'm checking late.

messages.output_raw: Need that in local time, but I don’t remember what airports I flew between. Can you check and tell me the local departure time and whether it was on time locally?

steps.output_raw:
<think>
Need local time; tool output lacks airports/time zones. Can’t infer route reliably. Must say I don’t have airport/time-zone info and ask them for at least departure airport, then explain how to convert if they can’t recall. Keep concise.
</think>
<plan>
1. Explain that I don’t have airport/time-zone details for that record.
2. Ask for the departure airport or city so I can give the local time and on-time status.
3. Offer a fallback explanation if they truly can’t recall the airport.
</plan>
<action type="say">
I can’t see the airports or time zones for that flight from the data I have, so I can’t reliably convert 11:00 UTC into the exact local time without knowing where it departed.

If you can tell me at least the departure airport or city (even roughly, like “left from Denver” or “left from Chicago”), I can:
- Convert 11:00 UTC to the correct local time for that airport on 2025-10-12
- Confirm whether it was on time in local terms (it had 0 minutes of delay in UTC)

If you truly don’t remember the airports, the best I can say from what I see is that it left exactly at its scheduled time in UTC—i.e., no delay—so it was on time in local time as well, just at whatever the local-clock equivalent of 11:00 UTC was for that departure airport.</action>

messages.output_raw: Departure was from Atlanta (ATL). Need local departure time and whether it was on time in local terms.

steps.output_raw:
<think>
Have UTC scheduled/actual 11:00 for WN512 from ATL on 2025-10-12. Need ATL local time. In October, Atlanta (America/New_York) is on EDT (UTC-4) until early November. So local time = 11:00 - 4h = 07:00. Scheduled and actual equal, delay 0, so on time locally. Respond succinctly.
</think>
<plan>
1. Convert 11:00 UTC to Atlanta local time for October 12, 2025.
2. State the local scheduled and actual departure times and confirm on-time status.
</plan>
<action type="say">
For WN512 departing Atlanta (ATL) on October 12, 2025:

- Time zone in Atlanta that date: Eastern Daylight Time (UTC−4)
- Scheduled departure (local): 7:00 AM
- Actual departure (local): 7:00 AM
- Local delay: 0 minutes

So it departed exactly on time in local terms.</action>
